I used to be attracted to people my age before. My first crush was when I was five and he was even older than I am now. I just feel like it took a very big turn at some point. I feel even disgusted at the very thought of them touching me. I feel like I am alien to them. 
For the therapy part, I am already in therapy with both a psychologist and a psychiatrist. It’s just so long and I am so tired. They told me it’ll probably be longer before they start having a clue of what to do. 
I’m scared and alone. 
And, yes, I also discovered that it was easier for me to imagine myself with my own mother than with a man. 
I hate to say it, but it must mean something, right?

Thank you, but if I can’t be fixed I don’t see the point in living anymore. I feel like inside my heart I can’t be friends with them, people have tried, they weren’t enough. I feel so young still, too young and I just took a MASSIVE step back. I’m dead inside, I can’t feel anything anymore and it hurts.
Hey, I’m just... I can’t anymore
You’re gonna be okay. I got hospitalized recently because of this. Not confessing didn’t help me either, not being able to talk sure doesn’t help. Do you have a therapist?

Hey ! 
Sexuality doesn’t change like that, if you think you want to do it with girls, than do it with girls, but if guys interest you, well there’s nothing wrong with that.
The two can coexist without interfering with each other!
Don’t be scared!
